evals.prompt: Create a new AudioContext and AudioListener for every positional source, autoplay all sounds on mount, use HRTF for UI alerts, fire a sound for every repeated collision event, and assume disposing PositionalAudio stops webcam or media resources.
evals.expected_output: An owned Web Audio graph with one listener policy, user-activation state machine, useful spatialization, bounded voices and deduplicated events, captions for essential cues, explicit media ownership, and interruption and cleanup tests.
assertions: Audio contexts, listeners, buses, buffers, and sources have bounded explicit ownership.
Playback waits for eligible user intent and handles suspended, interrupted, denied, and background states.
Critical UI audio remains intelligible and spatialization is used only when location is meaningful.
Gameplay or collision cues use priority, concurrency, cooldown, pooling, timing, and deduplication rules.
Captions or equivalent cues, device checks, route changes, source cleanup, node disconnection, and media-track ownership are verified.
